title: presubmit: add toolchain profiles and lightweight runtime-boot sequencing to cut setup latency
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Presubmit job setup time accounts for a large portion of feedback latency for small changes. This PR introduces "toolchain profiles" — declarative, small manifests that precompute and cache the minimal set of environment and dependency boot steps needed per change class — and a lightweight runtime-boot sequencing layer that defers nonessential initialization until after tests have started. The goal is to reduce cold presubmit setup time by 30-60% for common fastpaths (docs, small JS/TS changes, single-package Python fixes) without affecting full integration runs.

Summary of changes: 1) Add a profiles/ directory with three canonical profiles (minimal-js, minimal-py, full) and a profile resolver that maps changed files to an appropriate profile. 2) Implement runtime-boot sequencing in the presubmit runner: early path performs toolchain activation, cache warm, and test discovery; deferred path performs heavy language server warmups, optional cross-language tool downloads, and large binary unpack steps. 3) CI templates updated to accept a profile hint and to opt into deferred-init gating for fastpath lanes. 4) Add telemetry hooks and metrics (setup_time_ms, deferred_init_time_ms, cache_hit) and dashboard README. 5) Migration shim to fall back to legacy behavior when unknown profiles are detected.

Testing and validation: All unit tests for the resolver and runner added. End-to-end smoke runs executed in the staging CI lane across 50 representative small PRs: median setup time dropped from 68s to 28s; 90th percentile dropped from 220s to 95s. We ran full integration on main once before merging to ensure no regressions.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-3214) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Staging E2E runs completed with telemetry - [x] Migration shim and opt-out implemented - [x] Docs updated (presubmit README + dashboard README) - [x] Rollout plan: enable fastpath lanes for non-suspicious PRs by default, hold full integration lanes unchanged.

Rollout notes: The change is gated by CI labels: adding label ci/fastpath will trigger the fastpath runner using profiles; by default the resolver will select a conservative profile if detection is uncertain. If customers or internal teams see unexpected behavior they can append ci/legacy-run to force pre-change behavior. A monitoring alert (SLO: setup_time_ms > 3000) is added to the presubmit dashboard.

Related: reduces noise from long presubmit runs described in ENG-3320; incident SUP-1142 had a P0 where a dependency fetch caused repeated presubmit flakes and motivated deferred-init.

Files changed (high level): - presubmit/runner.go: introduce sequencing and profile resolver hooks - profiles/minimal-js.yaml, profiles/minimal-py.yaml, profiles/full.yaml - ci/templates/presubmit-fastpath.yml - tools/telemetry/presubmit_metrics.go - docs/presubmit-profiles.md - scripts/staging-runner.sh (test harness updates).

release_notes: Introduce presubmit toolchain profiles and deferred runtime-boot sequencing to reduce presubmit setup latency for fastpath CI lanes. Add metrics and dashboard README. Migration shim included to preserve legacy behavior.
notes_for_rollout: Start by enabling in the 'fast feedback' CI lane for non-suspicious PRs. Monitor presubmit.setup_time_ms and deferred_init_time_ms; watch for increased test flakes for 72 hours post-rollout. Provide an internal troubleshooting doc for teams to opt-out via label.
changelog_entry: presubmit: add toolchain profiles and deferred-init sequencing to cut CI setup time (ENG-3214)
migration_instructions: Profiles are additive. If a repo does not include a profiles/* entry, the resolver will select 'full' by default. To customize, add a profiles/<repo>-minimal.yaml and register it in presubmit/config.yaml. To opt out globally add label ci/legacy-run to the PR.
post_merge_tasks: 1) Turn on telemetry retention to 30d for presubmit metrics. 2) Run rollout audit after 48h and 7d. 3) Follow up with a separate PR to expand profile granularity for monorepos.
qa_summary: Unit tests for resolver and sequencing added. Staging smoke tests over 50 small PRs; full integration run on main. No test regressions observed. Observability gauge added to detect setup regressions.
estimated_impact: average presubmit setup time reduced by ~58% on targeted fastpaths; CI cost per small PR reduced due to shorter runner timeouts and fewer cache cold starts
